HasBuiltInOverlay.rationale: `public override bool HasBuiltInOverlay => true` (Infection.cs:18) tells the card renderer the art already includes its own overlay frame. Presentation, out of scope, and the sim has no card-visual layer.

CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ CardKeyword.Unplayable }` (Infection.cs:22) == `is_playable = False`. No Ethereal, so unlike card/dazed this Status stays in hand and keeps hurting.

ctor.issue: STATUS / STATUS / NONE map exactly. The canonical energy cost is -1 in C# and 0 in the sim. `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers` returns early on `_base < 0` (CardEnergyCost.cs:100-103), so the game's unplayable card is immune to every cost modifier; the sim runs a base of 0 through the full modifier chain (cards/base.py:222-232). Only what is READ diverges. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/ascenders_bane's ctor entry (rule 3). DORMANT: every ported cost reader filters `> 0` or skips `<= 1`, and events/infested_automaton.py:35 filters pool_card_ids(), which holds no curses or statuses.

CanonicalVars.maps_to: nothing -- the sim inlines 3 at the damage site (infection.py:164)
CanonicalVars.issue: `new DamageVar(3m, ValueProp.Unpowered | ValueProp.Move)` (Infection.cs:20) is a printed var with no `_damage` in `_init_vars`, so `Card.base_damage` returns None. The PROP SET is right: the sim passes no explicit props and `DamageCmd.deal` infers `DamageProps.CARD_UNPOWERED` (UNPOWERED | MOVE) from `is_unpowered = True` (cmds.py:44-50, infection.py:153), so the 3 damage is not Strength-scaled and IS blockable on both sides -- identical to card/burn and card/decay. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/bad_luck's CanonicalVars entry (rule 3): a printed DynamicVar with no `_`-attribute in `_init_vars`, so the sim's printed-number API reports the default and `full_env.card_features` (full_env.py:455-489) encodes the card wrongly for the policy. DORMANT for game fidelity, LIVE for the observation encoder.

OnTurnEndInHand.rationale: `CreatureCmd.Damage(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Damage, this)` (Infection.cs:39) -- passing the VAR, so the props ride along -- == `DamageCmd.deal(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, 3, dealer=None, card=self)`. Explicit null dealer on both sides. Presentation, folded in: the bloody-impact VFX and the NWormyImpactVfx node (33-38).

OnPlay.rationale: Infection.cs declares no OnPlay and the card is Unplayable.
